create_Runner_subclass: create a subclass of Runner that implements run, save_state, and load_state abstract methods
test_MockRunner: test the MockRunner class by instantiating with x, y, z values and calling run to get their sum
implement_PreemptableMixin: implement a PreemptableMixin subclass that adds STOPFAIR preemption and atomic checkpointing to a Runner
save_state_atomic_checkpoint: save state atomically using PreemptableMixin save_state which writes to a temp dir then renames into place
handle_stopfair_preemption: handle STOPFAIR preemption by calling handle_stopfair to save state to the preemption checkpoint directory
